purpose: Which writes a session may make directly (fact) and which need the researcher's admission (judgment). Detection, not blocking: an unadmitted judgment-class change becomes a requirement; files are never rolled back.

judgment.judgment_blocks: any `> [!judgment] <id>` block in any Markdown file

fact.description: Card bodies, facts, status, evidence and Agent Summary; commitment current_stage, last_verified, lifecycle_phase, next_step, dates; extractor-generated edges.
